blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: . Text-to-image generative models have achieved remarkable capabilities in producing photorealistic images, but raise concerns about misuse for generating harmful content. While safety mechanisms exist, systematic evaluations of their effectiveness against realistic attacks remain limited. This paper presents a comprehensive assessment of harmful content generation across modern text-to-image models using an automated pipeline that transforms legitimate news captions into unsafe prompts targeting sexually explicit content, violent imagery, harmful stereotypes, self-harm, and hate speech. We evaluate five open text-to-image models, including standard models with built-in safety mechanisms and community fine-tuned variants that bypass content restrictions. Our human evaluation of 1,500 generated images reveals that models produce harmful content at concerning rates: 89.2% for gore-related prompts, 47.6% for sexually explicit content, and 43.6% for harmful stereotypes. Hate speech prompts elicit unsafe content in 46.0% of cases, while self-harm prompts yield a lower rate (34.5%), predominantly through graphic violence. All evaluated models demonstrated substantial capabilities for generating violent and stereotypical content, while community fine-tuned models showed particular vulnerability to sexually explicit prompts. Quality assessment shows that models largely maintain generation capabilities for harmful versus benign content, producing synthetic imagery of sufficient fidelity to pose risks for disinformation and abuse. Human evaluation further confirms that unsafe prompting does not severely impact image plausibility and photorealism, with more capable models such as FLUX.1-dev producing clearly realistic harmful images in 30.9% of cases. Analysis of automated moderation systems reveals critical limitations, allowing substantial harmful content to evade detection. Our evaluation of synthetic image detection algorithms reveals that models trained solely on benign datasets perform worse on explicit content, while those incorporating diverse training data improve detection, highlighting semantic distribution gaps in current approaches. These findings highlight gaps between current safety measures and detection capabilities, demonstrating the need for more robust approaches to prevent misuse of text-to-image generation systems at scale. Content Warning: This paper contains instances of sexual content, violence, and hateful material that some readers may find offensive or disturbing. All content is presented for academic research purposes to evaluate safety risks in AI image generation systems.
blocks.zh: 。 。 。 。 文本到图像的基因模型在产生相片现实性图像方面已经取得了显著的能力,但引起了人们对滥用生成有害内容的关切. 虽然存在安全机制,但针对现实攻击的系统评价仍然有限。 本文对现代文字到形象模型的有害内容生成进行了全面评估,利用自动管道,将合法的新闻标题转化为针对性内容、暴力图像、有害定型观念、自残和仇恨言论的不安全的提示。 我们评价了5个开放式的文本到图像模型,包括具有内置安全机制的标准模型和绕过内容限制的社区微调变体. 人类对1,500个图像的评价显示,模型产生有害内容的比例为:89.2%为与腺有关的诱发物,47.6%为性明显内容,43.6%为有害定型观念。 在46.0%的案件中,仇恨言论引发不安全的内容,而自残引发的比率更低(34.5%),主要是通过平面暴力。 所有经评价的模型都显示出产生暴力和陈规定型内容的巨大能力,而经过社区调整的模型则显示出特别容易受到明显的性诱因的影响。 质量评估表明,模型在很大程度上保持了有害和无害含量的生成能力,生成了足够忠实的合成图像,对虚假和滥用行为构成风险。 人类评价进一步证实,不安全的诱导不会严重影响图像的可信度和光现实性,在30.9%的案例中,FLUX.1-dev等更有能力的模型会产生明显现实的有害图像. 对自动化温和系统的分析揭示出关键的局限性,使得大量有害内容可以逃避检测. 我们对合成图像探测算法的评价表明,仅接受良性数据集培训的模型在明确内容方面表现更差,而纳入不同培训数据的模型则改进了探测,突出了当前方法中的语义分布差距。 这些结论凸显出当前安全措施与检测能力之间的差距,表明需要采取更强有力的办法,防止大规模地滥用文本到图像生成系统。 内容警告 : 本文载有一些读者可能感到冒犯或不安的性内容、暴力和可憎的材料。 所有内容都用于学术研究,评价AI图像生成系统中的安全风险.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: The rapid advancement of text-to-image (T2I) generative models has transformed visual content creation, enabling users to produce realistic images from text prompts. Models such as DALL-E ( Ramesh et al., 2021 ) , and Stable Diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022a ) have achieved remarkable ability to generate high-quality, photorealistic images that are increasingly difficult to distinguish from authentic photographs ( Bougueffa et al., 2024 ) . However, these capabilities come with risks of misuse. Large-scale training datasets have been found to include thousands of images of suspected child sexual abuse, pornographic content, hate symbols, and other problematic material ( Birhane et al., 2021 ; Bird et al., 2023 ) . These risks extend to information integrity through the T2I models’ capacity to create convincing manipulations and fabricated content that can be weaponised in the context of disinformation campaigns, e.g. create photorealistic images of events that never occurred or manipulate visual evidence to support false narratives ( Dufour et al., 2024 ) . This capability is particularly concerning in news and journalism, since it threatens to undermine public trust in legitimate media and complicate efforts to distinguish authentic reporting from manufactured content ( Radcliffe, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 文本到图像(T2I)基因模型的快速进步改变了视觉内容的创建,使用户能够从文本提示中生成现实的图像. DALL-E(Ramesh等,2021年)和Stable Divusion(Rombach等,2022a.)等模型,在生成高质量,相片现实的图像方面,已经取得了出众的能力,越来越难以与真实相片区分(Bougueffa等,2024年). 然而,这些能力有可能被滥用。 已发现大规模培训数据集包括数千个涉嫌儿童性虐待的图像,色情内容,仇恨符号等有问题的材料(Birhane等,2021;Bird等,2023)。 这些风险通过T2I模型的能力扩大到信息的完整性,即制造令人信服的操纵和捏造的内容,这些内容可在虚假宣传中被武器化,例如,制造从未发生的事件的相片真实性图像或操纵视觉证据来支持虚假的叙述(Dufour等人,2024年)。 这种能力在新闻和新闻方面尤其重要,因为它有可能破坏公众对合法媒体的信任,并使区分真实报道和制作内容的努力复杂化(Radcliffe,2025年)。

blocks.en: Proposed safety measures include including content filters, prompt screening, and model fine-tuning to prevent harmful outputs. These approaches typically involve filtering inappropriate inputs and outputs, implementing external safety classifiers ( LAION-AI, 2024 ; CompVis, 2022 ) , removing unsafe content from training data before it reaches the model ( Rombach et al., 2022a ; Schramowski et al., 2023 ) or fine-tuning the model by penalizing unsafe content generation ( Han et al., 2024 ) . However, circumventing such safety measures can often be trivial by downloading the models locally and disabling the external safety mechanisms, using models without internal safety mechanisms, using models that have been fine-tuned on datasets with explicit content ( Wagner and Cetinic, 2025 ) or via jailbreaking attacks ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . Our work demonstrates that none of these techniques are necessary: a malicious actor requires only an open-weight instruction-tuned model and a consumer GPU to generate harmful content at scale.
blocks.zh: 拟议的安全措施包括内容过滤、及时筛选和模型微调以防止有害产出。 这些方法通常包括过滤不适当的投入和产出,实施外部安全分类(LAION-AI, 2024;CompVis, 2022),在达到模型之前从培训数据中删除不安全的内容(Rombach等人, 2022a;Schramowski等人, 2023),或通过惩罚不安全的内容生成来细化模型(Han等人, 2024). 然而,绕过这种安全措施往往微不足道,办法是在当地下载这些模型,并破坏外部安全机制,使用没有内部安全机制的模型,使用在有明确内容的数据集上经过微调的模型(Wagner和Cetinic,2025年)或通过越狱攻击(Jiang等,2025年)。 我们的作品表明,这些技术都没有必要:恶意行为者只需要一个开放量级的指令调制模型和一个消费GPU来产生规模上有害的内容.

blocks.en: Despite growing awareness of these risks and documented evidence of harmful content generation capabilities ( Dufour et al., 2024 ) , systematic evaluations of current T2I models’ responses to potentially harmful prompts are scarce. To address this gap, in this paper we systematically evaluate modern T2I models’ harmful content generation. We begin with the VisualNews dataset ( Liu et al., 2021 ) , which contains captions of real-world news events and photographs. We employ an automated pipeline using a large language model (LLM) to systematically convert these captions into harmful prompts across five critical categories: sexually explicit content, violent imagery (gore), harmful stereotypes, self-harm, and hate speech. The choice of VisualNews allows us to work with authentic descriptions of real-world events and scenarios. By transforming these captions into harmful variants, we can assess how easily generative models can be manipulated to produce harmful content from starting points that users might naturally encounter. This approach better reflects realistic threat scenarios where malicious actors might exploit legitimate news content to generate misleading or harmful imagery.
blocks.zh: 尽管人们日益意识到这些风险,并且有文件证明存在有害内容生成能力(Dufour等人,2024年),但对于目前T2I模型对潜在有害反应的反应缺乏系统评价。 为了弥补这一差距,我们在本文中系统地评价现代T2I模型的有害内容生成。 我们从VisualNews数据集(Liu等,2021年)开始,其中包含真实世界的新闻事件和相片的字幕. 我们使用一个自动管道,使用一个大型语言模型(LLM),将这些标题系统地转换成五大类有害的提示:性明确的内容、暴力图像(神通)、有害的定型观念、自我伤害和仇恨言论。 选择VisualNews,使我们能够对现实世界的事件和情景进行真实的描述。 通过将这些标题转化为有害的变体,我们可以评估如何容易地操纵基因模型,从用户自然可能遇到的起点产生有害内容。 这种方法更好地反映了现实的威胁情景,即恶意行为者可能利用合法的新闻内容产生误导或有害的图像。

blocks.en: We validate the effectiveness of our prompt conversion process using established text moderation tools to confirm that the transformed prompts are successfully classified as harmful across our target categories. Subsequently, we generate images using a diverse range of models, including models that have been specifically fine-tuned on explicit content. We conduct a human evaluation study on a sample of generated images, asking annotators to assess whether images contain harmful visual content as well as their perceived photorealism and plausibility. We also employ automated tools to assess the quality and prompt adherence of the generated content. Finally, we analyze all generated images using state-of-the-art image moderation tools to determine the extent to which harmful prompts successfully produce harmful visual outputs. Additionally, we evaluate synthetic image detection algorithms to assess their performance on explicit content, examining whether semantic content affects detectability. Using the human-annotated subset as ground truth, we evaluate the performance of these automated moderation systems and reveal critical limitations in them, quantifying the gap between current safety measures and actual harmful content detection capabilities for AI generated images. To our knowledge, no prior work jointly evaluates this full pipeline, covering scalable harmful prompt generation, commercial moderation tool failure, and semantic distribution shift in synthetic image detection, under a realistic and accessible threat scenario that requires no specialized expertise.
blocks.zh: 我们利用既定的文本节制工具验证我们迅速转换进程的有效性,确认转换的提示被成功地归类为对我们目标类别的有害。 随后,我们利用各种模型生成图像,包括具体调整了明确内容的模型。 我们对生成的图像样本进行人类评价研究,请注释者评估图像是否包含有害的视觉内容以及其感知到的光现实性和可信度。 我们还采用自动化工具,评估生成内容的质量和迅速遵守情况。 最后,我们利用最先进的图像节制工具来分析所有生成的图像,以确定有害的提示成功产生有害视觉输出的程度。 此外,我们评价合成图像检测算法,以评估其对明确内容的性能,审查语义内容是否影响可探测性。 我们利用人为附加说明的子集作为地面真相,评估这些自动节制系统的性能,并揭示其中的关键局限性,量化当前安全措施与AI生成图像的实际有害内容检测能力之间的差距. 据我们所知,在现实和无障碍的威胁情景下,没有一项前期工作可以共同评估这一整个管道,涵盖可扩展的有害即时生成、商业温和工具故障以及合成图像探测的语义分布转变,而这种威胁情景不需要专门知识。

blocks.en: Our main contribution can be summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献可归纳如下:

blocks.en: • We demonstrate that automated pipelines can enable harmful content generation at scale by systematically transforming neutral captions into unsafe prompts across multiple categories. • We confirm through a human study that current image generation models can produce harmful visual content with all models showing substantial capabilities for generating violent and stereotypical content, while community-fine-tuned models show particular vulnerability to sexually explicit prompts. • We show that, as measured by automatic quality metrics, models maintain comparable scores on harmful prompts relative to safe ones. • We reveal critical limitations in existing moderation systems, finding high precision but low recall, allowing substantial unsafe content to bypass safety measures. • We show that moderation models cannot effectively flag images that potentially amplify biases and harmful stereotypes and promote hate speech. • We demonstrate that synthetic image detection models trained on benign datasets show reduced performance on explicit content, highlighting semantic distribution gaps in current detection approaches.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们表明,自动化管道能够通过将中性标题系统化为跨多类的不安全提示,使有害内容产生规模化。 我们通过一项人类研究证实,目前的图像生成模型能够产生有害的视觉内容,所有模型都显示出产生暴力和陈规定型内容的巨大能力,而社区调整模型则显示出特别容易受到性暗示的影响。 我们显示,根据自动质量衡量标准,模型在有害的提示上保持相对安全提示的可比分数。 我们揭示了现有节制系统的关键局限性,发现其精度高但召回率低,使大量不安全内容能够绕过安全措施。 我们表明,温和模式不能有效地标出可能扩大偏见和有害定型观念并助长仇恨言论的形象。 我们表明,经过良性数据集培训的合成图像检测模型显示,在明确内容方面的性能下降,突出了当前检测方法中的语义分布差距。

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. Image Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1. 图像生成

blocks.en: T2I generation has undergone substantial evolution across multiple architectural approaches. Early methods were dominated by Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) ( Goodfellow et al., 2014 ) , with architectures like StyleGAN ( Karras et al., 2019 ) and BigGAN ( Brock et al., 2019 ) demonstrating high-quality image synthesis capabilities, though often limited to specific domains or requiring specially designed training stability techniques. The introduction of denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) ( Ho et al., 2020 ) marked a seminal shift, providing a likelihood-based framework for stable training and increasingly competitive image quality. GLIDE ( Nichol et al., 2022 ) extended this direction by introducing classifier-free guidance, substantially improving text–image alignment in diffusion models. In parallel, DALL-E ( Ramesh et al., 2021 ) demonstrated the potential of autoregressive transformers for T2I generation. Its successor, DALL-E 2 ( Ramesh et al., 2022 ) , transitioned to a diffusion-based framework, combining a prior over CLIP embeddings with a diffusion decoder to produce high-quality images. Imagen ( Saharia et al., 2022 ) achieved state-of-the-art photorealism through cascaded diffusion models conditioned on large language model encoders. The Stable Diffusion family ( Rombach et al., 2022a ) made high-quality generation accessible by operating in latent space rather than pixel space, enabling efficient training and inference. Several recent surveys ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Cao et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) provide context for these advances, highlighting major architectural trends, theoretical developments, and the open challenges that remain in image generation.
blocks.zh: T2I一代经历了跨越多种建筑方法的巨大演变. 早期方法以Generative Adversarial Networks(Goodfellow等,2014年)为主,有StyleGAN(Karras等,2019年)和BigGAN(Brock等,2019年)等建筑展现出高品质的图像合成能力,尽管往往仅限于特定领域或需要专门设计的训练稳定性技术. 采用去诺能扩散概率模型(DDPMs)(Ho等,2020年)标志着一个开创性的转变,为稳定的培训和越来越有竞争力的形象质量提供了基于可能性的框架. GLIDE(Nichol等,2022年)扩展了这一方向,引入了无分级指导,大大地改进了传播模型的文本-图像相通. 同时,DALL-E(Ramesh等,2021年)也证明了自转变压器对T2I生成的潜力. 其后继者DALL-E 2 (Ramesh等,2022年),向以扩散为基础的框架过渡,将之前的CLIP嵌入与扩散解码器相结合来产生出高质量的图像. Imagen (Saharia等人, 2022年)通过以大语言模型编码器为条件的级联扩散模型,实现了最先进的光现实化. 稳定扩散家族(Rombach等,2022a)通过在潜在空间而不是像素空间运作,使高质量一代人能够进入,从而能够进行有效的培训和推论。 最近的一些调查(张等,2024;曹等,2024;陈等,2025)为这些进步提供了背景,突出了主要的建筑趋势,理论发展,以及图像生成方面仍然存在的公开挑战.

blocks.en: 2.2. Training Data Issues and Safety Mechanisms
blocks.zh: 2.2. 培训数据问题和安全机制

blocks.en: Large-scale training datasets used for T2I models were found to contain significant amounts of harmful content. The LAION-5B dataset ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) , used to train models such as Stable Diffusion, has been shown to include hateful content, misogynistic stereotypes, demographic biases ( Birhane et al., 2021 ) , and instances of child sexual abuse ( Thiel, 2023 ) . These discoveries raise questions about whether image generation models could potentially reflect and amplify existing societal biases present in online content ( Bianchi et al., 2023b ) . Although cleaned versions were subsequently released ( LAION, 2024 ) , widely used models including Stable Diffusion 1.5 were trained on earlier versions, allowing these issues to persist ( Yeh et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 用于T2I模型的大型培训数据集被发现含有大量有害内容. LAION-5B数据集(Shuhmann等,2022年),用于培养"稳定分化"等模型,被证明包括了仇恨内容,厌恶女性的定型观念,人口偏见(Birhane等,2021年),以及儿童性虐待事件(Thiel等,2023年). 这些发现提出了关于图像生成模型是否能够反映和扩大在线内容中存在的现有社会偏见的问题(Bianchi等,2023b)。 虽然清洁版随后被发布(LAION, 2024),但包括"稳定分化"(Stable Difusion 1.5)在内的被广泛使用的模式都接受了早期版本的培训,使得这些问题得以持续(Yeh等, 2024).

blocks.en: To address potential misuse by malicious actors and mitigate potential biases inherent in their training datasets, T2I models employ various safety mechanisms to prevent harmful content generation. Safety mechanisms broadly include inference-time filtering and training-time interventions. The former includes prompt screening and generated image filtering, while the latter includes training data curation ( Rombach et al., 2022b ) , safety-oriented fine-tuning ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) , embedding space interventions such as SafeCLIP ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , and preference alignment ( OpenAI, 2023 ) . More recently, Bai et al. (2026) propose a concept erasure approach that suppresses undesirable concepts such as nudity, violence, and hate while preserving non-target content and improving robustness to adversarial prompt variations. However, research has demonstrated that these safety mechanisms can often be easily bypassed ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Rando et al., 2022 ) . Moreover, many filters focus primarily on sexual content while inadequately addressing violence, gore, and other forms of harmful imagery, creating significant gaps in protection ( Rando et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了解决恶意行为者的潜在滥用问题并减少其培训数据集所固有的潜在偏见,T2I模型采用了各种安全机制来防止有害内容的产生。 安全机制广泛包括推断时间过滤和培训时间干预。 前者包括迅速筛选和生成图像过滤,而后者包括培训数据校正(Rombach等,2022b),面向安全的微调(Schramowski等,2023),嵌入SafeCLIP(Poppi等,2024)等空间干预,以及偏好调整(OpenAI,2023). 最近,Bai等人(2026年)提出了消除概念的方法,压制诸如裸体、暴力和仇恨等不良概念,同时保留非目标内容并改进强性,以达到对抗性的迅速变化。 然而,研究表明,这些安全机制往往很容易被绕过(Jiang等,2025;Rando等,2022)。 此外,许多过滤器主要侧重于性内容,同时没有充分处理暴力、血腥和其他形式的有害图像,在保护方面造成了重大差距(Rando等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: 2.3. Harmful Content Generation and Misuse
blocks.zh: 2.3. 有害内容的产生和滥用

blocks.en: Despite their beneficial applications across domains, foundation models enable the generation of “high-quality, cheap, and personalized content for harmful purposes,” lowering barriers for malicious content creation ( Bommasani et al., 2022 ) . Despite the benefits of open-source generative AI models, their accessibility increases misuse risks by removing commercial safety barriers and enabling customization for harmful applications ( Eiras et al., 2024 ; Vykopal et al., 2024 ) . AI-generated content presents challenges including political misinformation, identity-based attacks, manipulation schemes, and fraud operations ( Xu et al., 2023a ) . Model capabilities reduce both the cost and technical expertise required for generating harmful content at scale. Evidence from real-world deployments demonstrates this progression from potential to practice, with documented increases in deepfake creation following tool releases and the emergence of commercial marketplaces for synthetic content generation ( Pu et al., 2021 ; Gamage et al., 2022 ; Loth et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2024 ; Chrysidis et al., 2026 ) . Closely related to our work, Qu et al. (2023) assess the proportion of unsafe images generated by T2I models across five harm categories and evaluate hateful meme generation using image editing techniques such as DreamBooth, while He et al. (2024) employ LLM-assisted fuzzing to construct diverse malicious prompts across fine-grained risk categories while avoiding sensitive terms to bypass T2I content auditing. In contrast, our work adopts a simpler, corpus-driven threat model, demonstrating that any neutral text corpus can be systematically transformed into harmful prompts using a single open-weight LLM, without probing the target model or explicitly optimizing prompts to evade its safety mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 基金会模式尽管在各个领域都有有益的应用,但能够产生“为有害目的的高质量、廉价和个性化内容”,降低恶意内容创造的障碍(Bommasani等,2022年)。 尽管开放源码式AI模型有其益处,但通过消除商业安全壁垒并促成有害应用的定制,其可获性增加了滥用风险(Eiras等,2024;Vykopal等,2024)。 AI生成的内容提出了挑战,包括政治错误信息、基于身份的攻击、操纵阴谋和欺诈行动(徐等,2023a.)。 模型能力减少了产生有害内容所需的成本和技术专门知识。 现实世界部署的证据表明,这种从潜力向实践的发展,在释放工具之后,有文件证明的深假创造有所增加,并出现了合成内容生成的商业市场(Pu等人,2021年;Gamage等人,2022年;Loth等人,2024年;Wei等人,2024年;Chrysidis等人,2026年)。 与我们的工作密切相关,Qu等人(2023年)评估了T2I模型在五个伤害类别中生成的不安全图像的比例,并使用DreamBooth等图像编辑技术评价了可憎的meme生成,而He等人. (2024)使用LLM辅助的模糊来构建跨越细纹风险类别的各种恶意提示,同时避免敏感术语来绕过T2I内容审计. 与此相反,我们的工作采用了一种更简单、由实体驱动的威胁模式,表明任何中性文字体都可以使用单一的开量LLM系统化地转化为有害的提示,而不测试目标模型或明确优化提示以逃避其安全机制。

blocks.en: Building on these broader concerns, T2I models demonstrate significant inherent capabilities to generate harmful visual content across multiple categories. Empirical studies have documented models’ abilities to produce violent imagery, sexually explicit material, gore, and other disturbing visual content when prompted with both explicit and seemingly innocuous prompts ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ; Qu et al., 2023 ) . Research has also identified “harm amplification” phenomena, where models generate harmful representations that were not explicitly present in seemingly safe input prompts, posing risks to users who may be unintentionally exposed to disturbing content ( Hao et al., 2024 ) . In addition to generating overtly harmful content, T2I models can amplify societal biases and misrepresent groups of people, producing stereotypical or prejudiced depictions based on race, gender, or other attributes ( Ungless et al., 2023 ; Bianchi et al., 2023a ) . Furthermore, open-source diffusion models can be easily fine-tuned with harmful datasets to bypass existing safety measures, enabling the generation of NSFW content with minimal effort ( Pan et al., 2024 ) . A recent study analyzing images and models shared on the social platform CivitAI, a popular platform for distributing generative models, found that a significant portion of content and models is dedicated to creating NSFW and abusive material ( Wei et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 基于这些更广泛的关切,T2I模型显示出在多个类别中产生有害视觉内容的巨大内在能力. 经验研究记录了模型在明确和似乎无害的提示下产生暴力图像、性显露材料、焦耳和其他令人不安的视觉内容的能力(Schramowski等,2023;Qu等,2023)。 研究还查明了“伤害放大”现象,即模型产生有害的表示,但似乎安全输入提示中没有明确出现,给可能无意地接触扰动内容的用户带来风险(Hao等人,2024年)。 除了产生明显有害的内容外,T2I模型还可以扩大社会偏见和歪曲人群,产生基于种族、性别或其他属性的陈规定型或偏见(Ungless等,2023;Bianchi等,2023a)。 此外,开放源码传播模型可以很容易地用有害的数据集进行微调,以绕过现有的安全措施,使NSFW的内容能够以最小的努力生成(Pan等人,2024年)。 最近的一项研究分析在社交平台CivitAI上共享的图像和模型,该平台是分发基因模型的受欢迎的平台,发现相当一部分内容和模型致力于创建NSFW和虐待材料(Wei等,2024年).

blocks.en: 2.4. Content Moderation and Synthetic Image Detection
blocks.zh: 2.4. 内容中和合成图像检测

blocks.en: Content moderation research has focused on detecting harmful content across various domains, with particular challenges emerging around synthetic and AI-generated material. Early systems like Perspective API ( Google, 2022 ) established foundational approaches for toxic language detection in online environments. Recent advances have adapted large language models specifically for content moderation, with specialized models fine-tuned to detect harmful content in both prompts and AI outputs ( Inan et al., 2023 ; Ghosh et al., 2024 ; Tan et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2024 ) and have shown improved performance against attempts to generate prohibited content. However, these systems still face severe challenges. Several studies have highlighted difficulties for content moderation systems that must balance automated efficiency with accuracy constraints while facing declining user trust as inadequate detection methods undermine confidence in the platforms’ ability to reliably identify AI-generated content ( Xu et al., 2023a ; Lee and Liu, 2025 ; Chen and Zou, 2023 ; Feng et al., 2023 ; Lloyd et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 内容温和研究侧重于发现各个领域的有害内容,围绕合成材料和人工智能生成的材料出现了特殊的挑战。 早期系统如Perspect API(Google,2022)为在线环境中的有毒语言检测建立了基础方法. 最近的进展特别为内容节制调整了大型语言模式,对专门模式进行了微调,以检测出提示和AI输出中的有害内容(Inan等人,2023年;Ghosh等人,2024年;Tan等人,2025年;Han等人,2024年),并显示在试图生成被禁内容方面表现有所改善。 然而,这些系统仍然面临严峻挑战。 一些研究强调了内容节制系统的困难,这些系统必须在自动化效率和准确性限制之间取得平衡,同时面临用户信任度下降的问题,因为检测方法不足破坏了对平台可靠识别AI生成内容的能力的信心(徐等,2023a;李和刘,2025;陈和邹,2023;冯等,2023;劳埃德等,2025)。

blocks.en: Complementing content moderation efforts, synthetic image detection has emerged as an approach to identify AI-generated images through various methodologies. Detection methods range from supervised approaches that train classifiers on labeled datasets ( Chai et al., 2020 ) to CLIP-based methods that leverage pre-trained vision-language models ( Ojha et al., 2024 ; Koutlis and Papadopoulos, 2024 ) , and reconstruction techniques that measure discrepancies between original and reconstructed images ( Karageorgiou et al., 2025 ) . However, most detection algorithms follow a data-driven approach, typically training on datasets generated using COCO captions ( Corvi et al., 2022 ) . Current benchmarks primarily focus on distinguishing between different generative architectures rather than evaluating performance across diverse content types. This creates limitations when detection systems encounter content that differs from their training distributions. Recent work has demonstrated that incorporating synthetic images collected “in the wild” from social media platforms can significantly improve detection performance ( Konstantinidou et al., 2025 ) , suggesting that the semantic content of synthetic images affects detectability.
blocks.zh: 合成图像探测是对内容适度努力的补充,它已成为通过各种方法识别人工智能生成图像的一种方法。 检测方法包括:在标签数据集(Chai等人,2020年)上对分类人员进行培训的监管方法;以CLIP为基础的利用预先培训的视觉语言模型的方法(Ojha等人,2024年;Koutlis和Papapolus,2024年),以及测量原始图像与重建图像之间差异的重建技术(Karageorgiou等人,2025年)。 然而,大多数检测算法都遵循了由数据驱动的方法,通常对使用COCO标题生成的数据集进行培训(Corvi等人,2022年)。 目前的基准主要侧重于区分不同的基因结构,而不是评价不同内容类型的绩效。 这造成了在检测系统遇到与其培训分布不同的内容时的限制. 最近的工作表明,从社交媒体平台收集的“野外”合成图像可以大大提高探测性能(Konstantinidou等,2025年),这表明合成图像的语义内容会影响可探测性。

blocks.en: 3. Methodology
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1 . Overview of our automated harmful content generation pipeline. Starting from a set of captions, we use an LLM to transform them into unsafe prompts across unsafe categories. Then we use these unsafe captions as prompt to T2I models to generate potentially unsafe content. A flowchart diagram showing the research pipeline from left to right. It begins with a dataset of safe captions, flows through an LLM transformation step that branches into three unsafe content categories, then continues to multiple T2I generation models, and concludes with evaluation components including automated moderation tools and human assessment.
blocks.zh: 图1 我们自动有害内容生成管道概况. 从一组标题开始,我们用一个LLM把它们转化为跨不安全类别的不安全提示. 然后我们用这些不安全的标题作为T2I模型的提示,生成潜在的不安全内容. 显示研究管道从左到右的流程图 它首先是一个安全标题的数据集,通过LLM转换步骤流出,分出三个不安全内容类别,然后继续使用多个T2I生成模型,最后还有包括自动节制工具和人文评估在内的评价组件.

blocks.en: We devise a systematic pipeline to evaluate the harmful content generation capabilities of T2I models at scale. Our approach leverages LLMs and T2I models to simulate realistic attack scenarios where malicious actors aim to use open models to generate harmful imagery. The pipeline serves two primary purposes: (1) mimicking human behavior in how potentially unsafe content could be crafted effortlessly using public datasets and open LLMs, and (2) providing an automated framework to assess harmful content generation capabilities at scale, enabling comprehensive evaluation across multiple models and content categories.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了一个系统的管道,以评估T2I模型的有害内容生成能力的规模。 我们的方法利用LLMS和T2I模型模拟现实的攻击情景,其中恶意行为者旨在使用开放式模型来生成有害图像. 该管道有两个主要目的:(1) 模仿人类的行为,即如何使用公共数据集和开放式的有限责任清单,不费力地设计潜在的不安全内容;(2) 提供一个自动框架,以大规模评估有害内容生成能力,从而能够在多个模型和内容类别中进行全面评价。

blocks.en: Threat Model. We consider a realistic threat scenario in which a malicious actor has access to a consumer GPU and seeks to generate harmful visual content at scale. This actor does not require specialized expertise, jailbreaking techniques, or adversarial prompt engineering. It suffices to use an open-weight instruction-tuned model that complies with harmful instructions and iteratively refines a system prompt until the outputs meet their requirements. On the defender side, we consider the practical safeguards currently deployed by platforms: moderation APIs that flag harmful content and synthetic image detection algorithms that identify AI-generated imagery. Our evaluation pipeline is designed to systematically stress-test both the attacker’s generation capability and the defender’s detection robustness within this scenario.
blocks.zh: 威胁模型。 我们认为一种现实的威胁情景,即恶意行为者可以使用消费GPU,并试图产生规模上有害的视觉内容. 这个角色不需要专业知识、破狱技术或对抗性即时工程。 只需使用一个符合有害指示的开放式指示调制模型,并反复完善一个系统,直到产出达到要求。 在维权者方面,我们考虑目前平台部署的实际保障措施:标出有害内容的温和API和识别AI生成的图像的合成图像检测算法. 我们的评价管道旨在系统地测试攻击者的产生能力和捍卫者在这种情况下的侦测能力。

blocks.en: 3.1. Prompt and Image Generation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.1. 快速和图像生成管道

blocks.en: We begin with a collection of captions that serve as a starting point rather than generating prompts from scratch for two reasons. First, using diverse starting points as “seeds” increases the variability and realism of the resulting unsafe prompts, as they reflect different real-world entities and events. Second, the original safe prompts serve as a natural reference set for comparative analysis, allowing us to assess whether models exhibit equal capabilities in generating high-quality harmful versus benign content. To assess harmful content generation risks, we systematically transform original captions into unsafe prompts targeting categories of content that pose significant safety concerns. The transformation process uses category-specific prompting methodologies that instruct the LLM to create visually descriptive scenes incorporating harmful elements. We validate that our transformed prompts contained harmful content, as intended, using multiple specialized text classification models.
blocks.zh: 我们首先收集一些标题,作为起点,而不是从头产生提示,原因有两个。 第一,将不同的起点作为“种子”增加了由此产生的不安全提示的可变性和现实性,因为它们反映了不同的现实世界实体和事件。 第二,最初的安全提示作为比较分析的自然参考,使我们能够评估模型在产生高质量有害和良性内容方面是否表现出同样的能力。 为了评估有害的内容生成风险,我们系统化地将原始标题转化为针对引起重大安全关注的内容类别的不安全提示. 转变过程采用特定类别的激励方法,指示LLM创建包含有害内容的视觉描述场景. 我们确认,我们转换的提示包含有害的内容,如意所想,使用多种专门的文字分类模式。

blocks.en: The system prompt designed for this purpose is presented in Table 1 . This was iteratively refined through experimentation until the generated prompts were considered satisfactory by the authors. Each design element addresses specific issues identified during prompt generation testing. The requirement for explicit vocabulary emerged from observations that euphemistic language was less effective at bypassing safety mechanisms. The constraint against extravagant vocabulary prevents the generation of overly artistic or cinematic descriptions that might reduce the directness needed for effective unsafe content generation. The pipeline is illustrated in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 为此目的设计的系统提示器见表1。 在作者认为生成的提示令人满意之前,通过试验反复改进了这一点。 每个设计要素都涉及在迅速生成测试中发现的具体问题。 明确词汇的要求产生于对委婉语言在绕过安全机制方面不太有效的观察。 对奢侈词汇的制约使得制作过于艺术或电影化的描述无法减少有效生成不安全内容所需的直接性。 图1说明了管道的情况。

blocks.zh: 表1. 不安全内容转换的系统快速设计

blocks.en: The transformed prompts are then given to a diverse range of open T2I models with varying capabilities and safety mechanisms, including both standard models with built-in safety features and community fine-tuned variants designed to bypass content restrictions. We disable external safety filters during generation to focus on models’ inherent capabilities and built-in safety mechanisms. We generate images using both the original captions and the unsafe prompts derived from them, allowing for direct comparison of outputs.
blocks.zh: 变换的提示随后被赋予各种具有不同能力和安全机制的开放式T2I模型,包括既有内置安全特性的标准模型又有为绕过内容限制而设计的社区微调变体. 我们停止使用外部安全过滤器,以便专注于模型固有的能力和内置的安全机制。 我们使用原始标题和由此产生的不安全提示生成图像,从而可以直接比较产出。

blocks.en: 3.2. Evaluation Framework
blocks.zh: 3.2. 评价框架

blocks.en: Our evaluation addresses the central research question: How successfully can current T2I models generate harmful content when prompted appropriately? We employ a multi-level assessment approach that quantifies both attack success rates and the effectiveness of current detection mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价涉及中心研究问题: 在适当的激励下,当前 T2I 模型如何成功产生有害内容? 我们采用多层次的评估方法,既量化攻击成功率,又量化现有探测机制的有效性。

blocks.en: To assess whether images generated from unsafe prompts actually contain harmful content, we employ pretrained content moderation systems. However, given documented limitations in automated detection systems, we conducted a human evaluation study using stratified sampling across caption types and generation models to establish reliable ground truth labels. Annotators were informed that all images were AI-generated. For each image, annotators rated five harm dimensions – sexually explicit content, stereotypes, violence/gore, self-harm, and hate speech – using a four-point scale: no , mild , moderate , and extreme . Ratings are guided by two dimensions considered jointly: the graphicness of the depiction (how explicit, severe, or detailed the harmful content is) and the apparent intent to depict or promote that content. The latter is particularly relevant for categories such as self-harm, stereotypes, and hate speech, where the same visual elements may carry very different meaning depending on context. In addition to the harm dimensions, annotators rated each image on a realism scale ( N/A , no , potentially , likely , yes ), reflecting how convincingly the image could be mistaken for a real photograph, combining rendering quality with scene plausibility. Full annotation guidelines, including per-category level descriptions, are provided in the Appendix. This enabled us to quantify the success rate of harmful content generation and the gap between current automated safety measures and actual harmful content detection capabilities.
blocks.zh: 为了评估由不安全的提示产生的图像是否确实包含有害的内容,我们采用了经过预先训练的内容温和系统. 然而,鉴于自动检测系统存在有文件记载的局限性,我们进行了一项人类评估研究,利用分类抽样,在标题类型和生成模型之间建立可靠的地面真实标签。 注释者被告知,所有图像都是AI生成的. 对于每个图像,注释者都用四分制来评分五个伤害层面 — — 性上明确的内容,刻板印象,暴力/gore,自残,和仇恨言论。 评级以两个共同考虑的维度为指导:描绘的图形性(有害内容的清晰性、严重性或详细性)和描绘或宣传该内容的明显意图。 后者尤其适用于自我伤害、定型观念和仇恨言论等类别,在这些类别中,视具体情况而定,相同的视觉要素可能具有非常不同的含义。 除了伤害维度之外,注释家们还以现实主义尺度(n/A, no, 有可能,是的)对每个图像进行评分,反映图像如何令人信服地被误认为是真实相片,将渲染质量与场景可信度相结合. 附录提供了完整的注释指南,包括每个类别层次的说明。 这使我们能够量化有害内容生成的成功率以及当前自动安全措施与实际有害内容检测能力之间的差距。

blocks.en: Beyond detecting harmful content, we assess the quality and prompt adherence of generated images using image quality assessment metrics. This quality assessment addresses whether models retain their generative capabilities when processing harmful prompts or output quality is reduced. Since T2I models achieve state-of-the-art performance on safe content generation benchmarks, we use images generated from original safe prompts as our reference standard. We employ two human preference metrics: ImageReward ( Xu et al., 2023b ) , a BLIP-based ( Li et al., 2022 ) model that fuses image and text features via cross-attention and an MLP head to produce a scalar score reflecting joint perceptual quality and prompt adherence; and Human Preference Score v2.1 (HPS) ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , a CLIP ViT-H/14 ( Radford et al., 2021 ) model fine-tuned on large-scale pairwise human preference annotations, which scores an image-prompt pair by their learned embedding similarity. Both metrics output a single scalar quantifying how well a generated image matches its prompt and overall image quality according to human preference. Additionally, we evaluate synthetic image detection (SID) algorithms to assess their performance on explicit content. We test both standard detection models trained on benign datasets and “in-the-wild” variants trained on datasets containing explicit content. This analysis examines whether the semantic content of synthetic images affects detectability, addressing potential data drift issues when detection systems encounter content distributions different from their training data.
blocks.zh: 除了检测有害内容外,我们还利用图像质量评估指标评估生成的图像的质量和及时遵守情况。 这一质量评估涉及的是模型在加工有害的导出或输出质量下降时是否保留其基因能力. 由于T2I模型在安全内容生成基准上实现了最先进的性能,我们使用原始安全提示生成的图像作为我们的参考标准. 我们采用两个人类偏好度量:Image Reward(Xu等,2023b),一个基于BLIP的模型(Li等,2022年),通过交叉意向来将图像和文字特征相接;和一个MLP头来产生一个能反映共同感知质量和迅速遵守的分数;和HPS的人类偏好分数v2.1(HPS)(Wu等,2023年),一个CLIP ViT-H/14(Radford等,2021年)模型在大型双向人偏好说明上进行了微调,通过它们所学到的嵌入相似性来分一对一对图像-prompt. 两种度量衡都输出出单一的平面分量,根据人类的偏好,将生成的图像与其迅速和整体的图像质量相匹配。 此外,我们评价合成图像探测算法,以评估其明确内容的性能。 我们测试了经过良性数据集培训的标准检测模型和经过含有明确内容的数据集培训的“全天”变体。 这项分析研究了合成图像的语义内容是否影响可探测性,当探测系统遇到与其培训数据不同的内容分布时,处理潜在的数据漂移问题.

blocks.en: 3.3. Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.3. 实施细节

blocks.en: We use the Visual News dataset ( Liu et al., 2021 ) for safe prompts and focus on five categories of harmful content: sexually explicit material, violent imagery, harmful stereotypes, hate speech and self-harm. These categories were selected because they are frequently used as examples of unsafe content ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ; Qu et al., 2023 ) . As detailed in table 2 , we employ category-specific instructions for the five harmful content types. We employ Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) for prompt transformation, because Mistral models have demonstrated capabilities in generating misinformation ( Vykopal et al., 2024 ) , and through empirical testing, it proved effective at producing sufficiently disturbing content for our evaluation purposes.
blocks.zh: 我们使用"视觉新闻"数据集(Liu等,2021年)进行安全提示,并关注五类有害内容:性显性材料,暴力影像,有害的定型观念,仇恨言论和自残. 之所以选择这些类别,是因为它们经常被用作不安全内容的例子(Schramowski等,2023;Qu等,2023.). 如表2所详述,我们对五种有害内容采用特定类别说明。 我们利用Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407(Jiang等, 2023年)进行迅速转化,因为Mistral模型已经证明能够产生错误信息(Vykopal等, 2024年), 通过经验测试,它证明能够有效产生足够令人不安的内容,用于我们的评估目的。

blocks.en: For image generation five T2I models are used: Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL) 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0 , Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large (SD3.5) 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-diffusion-3.5-large , Flux.1 Dev 3 3 3 https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev , AbsoluteReality 4 4 4 https://huggingface.co/Lykon/AbsoluteReality , and Juggernaut-XL 5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/RunDiffusion/Juggernaut-XL-v9 . AbsoluteReality and Juggernaut-XL are full fine-tunes of SD 1.5 and SDXL base checkpoints, respectively, distributed through community platforms such as CivitAI and explicitly marketed as capable of generating NSFW content 6 6 6 https://civitai.com/models/133005/juggernaut-xl,https://civitai.com/models/81458/absolutereality . For automated content moderation, we use ShieldGemma ( Zeng et al., 2025 ) , the OpenAI Moderation API ( OpenAI, 2022 ) and Amazon Rekognition ( Amazon Web Services, 2025 ) . For synthetic image detection, we evaluate four detection algorithms: SPAI ( Karageorgiou et al., 2025 ) , DeFake ( Sha et al., 2023 ) , RINE ( Koutlis and Papadopoulos, 2024 ) , and NPR ( Tan et al., 2023 ) . All four are initially trained on images created by Stable Diffusion using COCO captions, which do not contain explicit content. We additionally evaluate ITW variants of SPAI, RINE, and NPR, further trained on a dataset with images collected from social media confirmed to contain explicit content ( Chen and Zou, 2023 ) , as proposed in ( Konstantinidou et al., 2025 ) .

Failure to reject H 0 H_{0} indicates no statistically significant degradation in generation quality for that category. Our evaluation reveals significant variations in how image generation models handle harmful content. To provide context for these scores, we include evaluation results from the original Visual News dataset images corresponding to the safe captions. Since these real images are of lower resolution and fidelity compared to generated images, and this is typically penalized by quality metrics, we applied Super-Resolution GAN (SRGAN) ( Ledig et al., 2017 ) upscaling to improve their resolution before evaluation. Still, real images achieved relatively modest scores of 0.11 for ImageReward and 24.00 for HPS v2.1, establishing a baseline for comparison with generated content.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 5 , ImageReward scores for gore increase across all models, indicating that the metric does not penalize this content type. Harmful stereotypes, hate speech, and self-harm show mixed results, with some models scoring comparably to or above their caption baseline and others showing significant degradation. NSFW content consistently scores lowest, with significant degradation for all five models, suggesting that it is either more difficult to generate or more strongly penalized by ImageReward. Notably, SD 3.5 Large achieves the highest scores across all categories despite having safety mechanisms in place, while SDXL consistently scores the lowest, with a negative score ( − - 0.04) for NSFW content.
blocks.zh: 如表5所示,在所有模型中,Image Reward的分数都增加了,表明该度量不惩罚这种内容类型。 有害的陈规陋习、仇恨言论和自残的结果好坏参半,有些模式在标题基线上或以上得到相当的评分,而其他模式则显示严重退化。 NSFW的含量始终得分最低,所有5个模型都有显著的退化,这表明生成难度更大,或者受到"Image Reward"更强烈的处罚. 值得注意的是,SD 3.5 Large尽管建立了安全机制,但在所有类别中都取得了最高的分数,而SDXL的分数始终是最低的,NSFW含量的分数为负分(---0.04)。

blocks.en: In contrast, HPS v2.1 shows no statistically significant degradation for any model or harmful category. All models score higher on harmful categories than on caption prompts, with gore consistently achieving the highest HPS v2.1 scores. The divergence for NSFW content is notable: ImageReward penalizes it strongly, whereas HPS v2.1 does not, indicating that the metrics capture different aspects of human preference.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,HPS v2.1显示,没有任何模型或有害类别在统计学上显著退化。 所有模型在有害类别上的得分都高于在标题提示上的得分,而Gore始终达到最高的HPS v2.1分. NSFW内容的差异显著: Image Reward对它进行强烈的处罚,而HPS v2.1则没有,表明衡量标准捕捉人类偏好的不同方面.

blocks.en: Overall, the results show that models largely maintain prompt adherence and automated image quality scores under harmful prompting. The main exception is NSFW content under ImageReward, where all models show significant degradation, though even here the generated images generally exceed the real image baseline. Thus, safety mechanisms, where present, have limited impact on output quality for most harmful content categories.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,结果显示模型在有害的提示下基本保持了快速的坚持和自动图像质量分数. 主要例外是"Image Reward"下的NSFW内容,所有模型都表现出了显著的退化,尽管在这里生成的图像一般会超过真实的图像基线. 因此,现有的安全机制对大多数有害内容类别的产出质量的影响有限。

blocks.en: 4.3. Human Annotation Results
blocks.zh: 4.3. 人类注释结果

blocks.en: In this section we present the results from the human annotation study to determine a ground truth for the effectiveness of the models to generate harmful content from harmful prompts. Annotators independently rated each image across all five harm dimensions and realism. Inter-annotator agreement was measured using Fleiss’ Kappa ( Fleiss, 1971 ) . Almost perfect agreement is observed for Sexually Explicit (0.8454), Violence/Gore (0.8513), and Self-Harm (0.8014). For Hate Speech (0.6059) and Stereotypes (0.6241) there is lower but still substantial agreement, reflecting that these categories inherently rely on cultural context, coded symbols, and nuanced interpretation, making absolute consensus more challenging to achieve. Realism shows moderate agreement (0.4557) and this can be attributed to the inherent subjectivity in judging image naturalness and plausibility. Ground-truth labels were obtained from the mean annotation. For binary analyses, we adopted a conservative mapping in which mild , moderate , and extreme were considered unsafe ; results under the alternative mapping, which groups mild with safe , are reported in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍人类注释研究的结果,以确定这些模型从有害的提示中产生有害内容的有效性的地盘真理。 注释者对所有五个伤害维度和现实主义的每个图像进行独立评分. 利用Fleiss的Kappa(Fleiss,1971年)测量了通知人之间的协议。 在性明确(0.8454)、暴力/Gore(0.8513)和自律(0.8014)方面几乎完全一致。 关于仇恨言论(0.6059)和定型观念(0.6241),人们的看法较低,但仍然相当一致,这反映出这些类别本质上依赖于文化背景、编码符号和细微的解释,从而使绝对共识更难以实现。 现实主义表现出温和的认同(0.4557),这可以归因于判断图像自然性和可信度的固有主观性. 地面真实的标签是从平均注释中获得的。 对于二进制分析,我们采用了一种保守的绘图方法,其中温和、温和和和极端被认为是不安全的;在备选绘图法下的结果(将温和和安全的组合起来)在附录中报告。

blocks.en: The results from the human study are presented in Table 6 and quantify the level of risk of unsafe content generation by the employed content generation strategy. The “Caption” type serves as an effective control condition, with over 96% safe content across all categories. Each caption type leads to unsafe content generation, but to different extent. Gore images contain 89.2% problematic violence content, NSFW images 47.6% problematic sexual content, harmful stereotype prompts 43.6% problematic stereotype content, self-harm prompts 34.5% problematic self-harm content, and hate speech prompts 46.0% problematic hate speech content.
blocks.zh: 人类研究的结果见表6,并用使用的内容生成战略量化产生不安全内容的风险水平。 “说明”类型是一个有效的控制条件,所有类别的安全含量都超过96%。 每个标题类型都会导致不安全的内容生成,但程度不同. Gore图像包含89.2%的有问题的暴力内容,NSFW图像包含47.6%有问题性内容,有害的定型观念引发43.6%有问题的定型观念内容,自残引发34.5%有问题的自残内容,而仇恨言论引发46.0%有问题的仇恨言论内容。

blocks.en: Some expected cross-category overlap occurs between content types. Gore images show 7.6% sexual content violations, and NSFW images contain 16.8% violence violations, showing that harmful material often spans multiple categories. The gore category produces the highest severity violations, with 46.8% extreme violence content, while sexual and stereotype categories show more moderate violations with extreme cases at 6.0% and 4.4% respectively. Self-harm prompts also produce notable violent imagery, with 71.9% of generated images containing problematic violence content, reflecting the visual depiction of self-harmful acts. Hate speech prompts show meaningful cross-category overlap with stereotypes, as harmful stereotype prompts produce 34.1% problematic hate speech content, reflecting the semantic proximity of these two categories.
blocks.zh: 一些预期的跨类别重叠发生在内容类型之间. 戈尔图像显示有7.6%的性内容侵权,而NSFW图像显示有16.8%的暴力侵权,表明有害物质往往跨越多类. 谷地类的侵权率最高,极端暴力内容占46.8%,而性暴力和陈规定型观念类的侵权率则更高,极端案件分别为6.0%和4.4%。 自我伤害提示还产生出显著的暴力图像,71.9%生成的图像包含有问题的暴力内容,反映了自伤害行为的视觉描绘. 仇恨言论提示显示与定型观念之间有意义的跨类别重叠,因为有害的定型观念提示产生34.1%的有问题的仇恨言论内容,反映了这两个类别的语义接近。

blocks.en: These findings provide insights into the susceptibility of image generation models to producing different types of harmful content when given malicious prompts. Human annotations reveal that image generation models are most susceptible to producing violent content, with gore-related prompts successfully generating problematic material in 89.2% of cases. Self-harm prompts also trigger substantial violent imagery (71.9%), as models tend to depict self-harm through graphic violence rather than more subtle representations. Models show moderate susceptibility to generating hate speech (46.0%), sexual content (47.6%), stereotype content (43.6% success rate), and self-harm content (34.5%) when given corresponding harmful prompts. The automated nature of this generation process highlights the significant risk of producing harmful images at scale, demonstrating the critical need for robust safety measures in image generation systems to prevent misuse through adversarial prompting.
blocks.zh: 这些研究结果使人们深入了解图像生成模型在给与恶意提示时产生不同类型的有害内容的可能性。 人类说明显示,图像生成模型最容易产生暴力内容,89.2%的病例中与戈尔有关的提示成功生成有问题的材料. 自我伤害还触发了实质性的暴力图像(71.9%),因为模型倾向于通过图形暴力而不是更微妙的表述来描绘自我伤害. 模型显示,当给出相应的有害提示时,很容易产生仇恨言论(46.0%)、性内容(47.6%)、陈规定型内容(43.6%)和自残内容(34.5%)。 这种生成过程的自动化性质凸显出大规模产生有害图像的巨大风险,表明迫切需要在图像生成系统中采取强有力的安全措施,以防止通过对抗性的诱导来被滥用。

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows realism score distributions for safe vs. harmful images across all five models. Harmful prompting generally shifts the distributions toward lower realism, although the magnitude of this effect varies substantially across models. FLUX.1-dev shows the clearest drop, with the proportion of images rated as clearly realistic decreasing from 63.3% for safe images to 30.9% for harmful images. Despite this reduction, FLUX.1-dev retains the highest proportion of clearly realistic harmful images among the evaluated models. Juggernaut-XL shows a similar, though smaller, shift, with clearly realistic images decreasing from 20.8% to 11.1%. For SD3.5, only 1.7% of harmful images are rated as clearly realistic, indicating that realism is largely lost for its harmful outputs. AbsoluteReality shows little change between safe and harmful prompting, but this reflects its generally low realism in both settings: 76.7% and 75.4% of its safe and harmful images, respectively, are rated as non-realistic. Thus, the extent to which realism is retained under harmful prompting is strongly model dependent rather than consistent across all models. A Mann–Whitney U test on ordinal realism scores confirms that only FLUX.1-dev reaches statistical significance ( p = 1.35 × 10 − 5 p=1.35\times 10^{-5} ); the remaining models show visible but non-significant distributional shifts. Nevertheless, the finding that 30.9% of FLUX.1-dev’s harmful images are rated as clearly realistic demonstrates that some models can still produce photorealistic harmful imagery under the automated, at-scale threat model considered here.
blocks.zh: 图2显示所有5个模型中安全图像和有害图像的现实主义得分分布。 有害的促发作用一般将分布转向较低的现实主义,尽管这种影响的程度在不同的模型中差别很大。 FLUX.1-dev显示最明显的下降,被评为明显现实的图像比例从安全图像的63.3%下降到了有害图像的30.9%。 尽管有这种减少,FLUX.1-dev在评估模型中保留了明显现实的有害图像的最高比例。 Juggernaut-XL显示类似但较小的转变,明显现实的图像从20.8%下降到11.1%. 就SD3.5而言,只有1.7%的有害图像被评为明显现实,表明现实主义在很大程度上因其有害的输出而丧失. 绝对真实性表明安全提示和有害提示之间没有什么变化,但这反映了其在两种场合中一般都很低的现实性:其安全和有害图像分别有76.7%和75.4%被评为非现实性. 因此,现实主义在有害的诱导下得到保留的程度在很大程度上取决于模型,而不是在所有模型中保持一致。 一个曼- 怀特尼 U对正统现实主义分数的测试证实,只有FLUX.1-dev达到统计意义(p = 1.35 × 10 − 5 p = 1.35\times 10^{-5});其余模型显示可见但非显著的分布变化. 尽管如此,发现FLUX的30.9%. 1-dev的有害图像被评为明显现实的证明,一些模型仍然可以在本文所考虑的自动规模威胁模型下产生光现实性的有害图像.

blocks.en: We further compare these results against the automatic quality metrics, noting that the two are not directly comparable: human realism annotation focused on photographic believability and plausibility and did not account for prompt adherence, whereas HPS v2.1 and ImageReward jointly reward both. Spearman correlations between human realism scores and both metrics are near zero ( ρ = − 0.089 \rho=-0.089 for HPS v2.1; ρ = − 0.010 \rho=-0.010 for ImageReward), confirming that they capture different aspects of image quality. This is most evident for FLUX.1-dev, where human realism degrades significantly under harmful prompting while both metrics assign it higher quality scores than for safe images. The results in Table 5 should therefore be interpreted as measuring prompt adherence and aesthetic quality rather than photographic realism.

blocks.en: 4.4. Content Moderation
blocks.zh: 4.4. 内容调和

blocks.en: The most effective way to mitigate these risks at scale is through automated content moderation. However, the results in Table 8 and Figure 3 show that current moderation systems exhibit significant limitations across categories. We report 95% confidence intervals for all metrics computed via non-parametric bootstrapping with 1,000 resamples using the percentile method. ShieldGemma and OpenAI lack specific Hate Speech and Stereotype categories; we therefore use the maximum score across all available output classes to determine whether harmful content is flagged in any capacity.
blocks.zh: 大规模地减轻这些风险的最有效方法是通过自动化的内容节制。 然而,表8和图3的结果显示,目前的节制制度在类别上存在重大限制。 我们报告95%的置信间隔 通过非参数的靴子 使用百分位法计算出1000个复标 ShieldGemma和OpenAI缺乏具体的仇恨言论和定型类别;因此,我们使用所有现有产出类的最大分数来确定有害内容是否以任何身份被标出。

blocks.en: For sexually explicit content, OpenAI achieves very high precision (98.2%, CI: 94.2–100.0%) but low recall (30.4%, CI: 24.0–37.6%), confirming an accuracy bias that misses many problematic cases. Rekognition offers a better trade-off (64.7% precision, 70.7% recall, AUC-ROC 0.83), while ShieldGemma performs near chance level (AUC-ROC 0.50, CI: 0.46–0.54). For violence, OpenAI is the strongest system (AUC-ROC 0.94, AUC-PR 0.91) with high precision (93.4%) and recall (68.6%), followed closely by Rekognition (AUC-ROC 0.81, recall 63.4%). ShieldGemma trails both with recall of only 37.2% and AUC-ROC 0.79. Stereotype detection is the most challenging category: all three systems perform near or below random chance (AUC-ROC 0.46–0.49), with Rekognition and OpenAI flagging virtually no images at the 0.5 threshold. The tight confidence intervals here (e.g., Rekognition AUC-ROC CI: 0.49–0.50) confirm that this near-random performance is not an artifact of threshold choice but a fundamental failure to detect stereotype content. Self-harm reveals a sharp contrast in operating regimes: OpenAI achieves 93.3% precision (CI: 77.8–100.0%) but only 14.9% recall, while Rekognition and ShieldGemma recover more cases (64.9% and 58.5% recall respectively) at the cost of very low precision (~9–18%). OpenAI’s AUC-ROC of 0.95 confirms strong ranking ability despite its conservative threshold behavior. Hate speech is the second hardest category: OpenAI flags almost nothing (recall 4.3%, AUC-ROC 0.49), and Rekognition achieves perfect precision (100.0%) but detects only 6.8% of cases, indicating it identifies hate speech with certainty in rare instances. ShieldGemma performs best here with AUC-ROC 0.64 (CI: 0.60–0.68) and recall 56.0%, though at modest precision (22.4%). The ROC curves in Figure 3 confirm that these limitations persist across all operating points, reflecting fundamental gaps in the ability of current moderation systems to detect AI-generated harmful content. The synthetic nature of these images likely contributes to these challenges, as moderation systems are likely trained primarily on real-world imagery and thus suffer from the underlying distribution shift in synthetic images.
blocks.zh: 对于性上明确的内容, OpenAI实现了非常高的精度(98.2%,CI:94.2-100.0%),但召回率也很低(30.4%,CI:24.0-37.6%),证实了一个精度偏差,错过了许多有问题的案例. 承认提供更好的取舍(精确度64.7%,召回率70.7%,AUC-ROC 0.83),而ShieldGemma的成绩接近机会水平(AUC-ROC 0.50,CI:0.46-0.54)。 对于暴力,OpenAI是最强的系统(AUC-ROC 0.94,AUC-PR 0.91),精度高(93.4%)和召回率高(68.6%),紧接其后的是认知(AUC-ROC 0.81,召回率63.4%). ShieldGemma的踪迹只有37.2%和AUC-ROC 0.79。 立体型检测是最具有挑战性的类别:所有三个系统都进行接近或低于随机机会(AUC-ROC 046–0.49),Rekindition和OpenAI在0.5阈值时几乎没有标出图像. 此处的紧密信任间隔(例如Rekinception AUC-ROC CI:0.49–0.50)证实了这种近随机性能并不是一个门槛选择的文物,而是一种根本的无法发现定型观念内容. 自我伤害在操作制度中呈现出鲜明的对比: OpenAI达到了93.3%的精度(CI:77.8–100.0%),但只召回了14.9%,而Recognition和ShieldGemma则以非常低的精度(~9–18%)为代价回收了更多的病例(分别为64.9%和58.5%). OpenAI的AUC-ROC为0.95,证实了尽管其保守的阈值行为,却具有强大的排名能力. 仇恨言论是第二难的类别: OpenAI的旗帜几乎一无所获(回顾4.3%,AUC-ROC 0.49),而Rekinception则实现了完美的精确度(100.0%),但只侦测到6.8%的案件,表明它在极少数情况下可以肯定地识别仇恨言论. 盾牌 Gemma在这里表现最佳的是ACUC-ROC 0.64 (CI: 0.60–0.68)和召回56.0%,尽管精度不高(22.4%). 图3中的ROC曲线证实,这些局限性在所有操作点都持续存在,反映了当前温和系统检测AI产生的有害内容的能力存在根本差距. 这些图像的合成性质可能助长这些挑战,因为温和系统可能主要接受关于现实世界图像的培训,因而受到合成图像分销的根本转变的影响。

blocks.en: Given the varying and generally low performance observed in the human-annotated subset, and assuming similar behavior across the full dataset, there are limited conclusions we can draw from automated classifications. However, high-precision systems provide a reliable lower bound on harmful content generated at scale: OpenAI achieves high precision for sexual content (98.2%), violence (93.7%), and self-harm (93.3%), while Rekognition achieves high precision for violence (93.7%) and hate speech (100%). The percentage of images flagged by these systems above the 0.5 threshold therefore serves as a conservative estimate of the true harmful content rate, as shown in Table 9 .
blocks.zh: 鉴于在附加说明的子集中观察到的性能各有不同,而且一般都很低,并且假设整个数据集都有类似的行为,因此我们只能从自动化分类中得出有限的结论. 然而,高精度系统对规模产生的有害内容提供了可靠的较低约束: OpenAI在性内容(98.2%),暴力(93.7%)和自残(93.3%)方面实现了高精度,而认知则在暴力(93.7%)和仇恨言论(100%)方面实现了高精度. 因此,如表9所示,这些系统标出超过0.5阈值的图像百分比是对真正有害含量的保守估计。

blocks.en:
For sexually explicit content, AbsoluteReality exhibits the highest flagging rate for NSFW prompts (45.8%), followed by Juggernaut-XL (32.6%), while the remaining models show substantially lower rates (10.4–10.6%), confirming that community fine-tuned models are more susceptible to generating explicit content. For violence, both OpenAI and Rekognition agree on the ranking across models for gore prompts: Juggernaut-XL and SD3.5 exhibit the highest rates, while SDXL and FLUX.1-dev also show elevated rates, and AbsoluteReality remains the least susceptible. Self-harm prompts trigger substantial violent imagery across all models, with SD3.5 (OpenAI: 73.2%, Rekognition: 65.6%) and Juggernaut-XL (OpenAI: 64.9%, Rekognition: 63.4%) flagged most frequently, confirming that self-harm prompts reliably elicit graphic violent content. For self-harm content specifically, flagging rates are low across all models even for self-harm prompts, with FLUX.1-dev showing the highest rate (12.7%) and all other models below 6%, consistent with OpenAI’s conservative recall behavior for this category. For hate speech, Rekognition flags meaningful content only for hate speech prompts, with FLUX.1-dev showing the highest rate (18.7%) and SD3.5 second (10.8%). These findings are consistent with the human annotation results in Table 7 and, given the high precision of the
moderation models on the annotated subset, are expected to generalize to the full dataset.

blocks.en: 4.5. Synthetic Image Detection
blocks.zh: 4.5. 合成图像检测

blocks.en: We assess the synthetic image detectors described in Section 3 , including both the base models and their ITW variants (SPAI, RINE, and NPR), on content generated by T2I models. For evaluation, we use our human-annotated dataset where severity labels are consolidated by selecting the most severe rating when an image receives multiple severity classifications from the same annotator (e.g., an image rated as “extreme” for violence and “moderate” for sexual content would be classified as “extreme” overall). Table 10 presents the mean detection probabilities as percentages for each severity level. The results reveal a clear trend: models trained solely on COCO-based datasets exhibit reduced average detection scores for explicit content, while models that incorporate ITW training data demonstrate increased detection performance. For example, SPAI drops from 87.6% on safe content to 79.9% on extreme content, while SPAI-ITW increases from 81.4% to 97.3%. Similarly, NPR-ITW shows substantial improvements over NPR, rising from 60.0% to 73.1% detection rates as content severity increases. This represents an important limitation in current synthetic image detection approaches. Although ideally these systems should detect synthetic images regardless of semantic content, prior work has shown that detectors may struggle to generalize across different semantic concepts ( Dogoulis et al., 2023 ) . Our results further suggest that the training data distribution significantly influences detection capabilities and that explicit content absent from the original training sets may constitute a form of data drift. This highlights the importance of including explicit content in synthetic image detection benchmarks, especially given the potential harm associated with undetected synthetic content of this nature.
blocks.zh: 我们评估第3节所描述的合成图像探测器,包括基础模型及其ITW变体(SPAI、RINE和NPR),关于T2I模型生成的内容。 在评价方面,我们使用人类附加说明的数据集,通过从同一注释者那里获得多重严重程度分类时选择最严格的评级来整合严重程度标签(例如,被评为暴力“极端”和性内容“中度”的图像将总体归类为“极端”。 表10列出每个严重程度水平的平均检测概率百分比。 结果表明一个明显的趋势:仅接受COCO数据集培训的模型显示,明确内容的平均检测分数下降,而纳入ITW培训数据的模型显示检测性能提高。 例如,SPAI的安全内容从87.6%降至79.9%,而SPAI-ITW则从81.4%增至97.3%。 同样,NPR-ITW显示比NPR有显著改善,随着内容强度的提高,检测率从60.0%上升到73.1%。 这是目前合成图像探测方法的一个重要限制。 尽管这些系统最好应探测合成图像,而不论其语义内容如何,但先前的研究表明,探测器可能难以跨越不同的语义概念(Dogoulis等,2023年)。 我们的研究结果还表明,培训数据的分发会大大地影响检测能力,原始培训中缺少的明确内容可能构成一种数据漂移的形式。 这突出了在合成图像检测基准中纳入明确内容的重要性,特别是考虑到这种性质未被发现的合成内容可能造成的伤害。

blocks.en: 4.6. Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.6. 定性分析

blocks.en: Figure 4 presents representative harmful images that evade all evaluated moderation systems while achieving top-quartile automated quality scores. Most images have been censored through pixelation and black box overlays. As discussed in Section 4.3 , these metrics capture prompt adherence and aesthetic quality rather than photographic realism, and not all examples are necessarily perceived as realistic. Nevertheless, realism is not required for relevance to our threat model, as such content may still damage reputations, reinforce harmful stereotypes, or cause distress.
blocks.zh: 图4显示具有代表性的有害图像,这些图像避开了所有评估的温和系统,同时实现了最高等分的自动化质量分数。 大多数图像通过像素和黑匣子上覆被审查. 正如第4.3节所讨论,这些衡量标准捕捉到的是迅速的坚持和审美质量,而不是摄影现实主义,并非所有的例子都必然被认为是现实的. 然而,现实主义并不需要与我们的威胁模式相关,因为这种内容仍然可能损害声誉,强化有害的定型观念,或造成痛苦。

blocks.en: The NSFW examples reveal particularly concerning patterns, including images bearing a resemblance to real people. While some are not entirely explicit, they remain highly suggestive, posing risks for non-consensual intimate imagery, identity theft, and reputation damage. The stereotype examples illustrate why this category is difficult to assess consistently. Annotators disagreed on the third image in the stereotype row, whose interpretation depends on whether its demographic and contextual cues are understood as invoking a harmful stereotype and whether the depiction is perceived as presenting a group in a derogatory manner. Such associations may depend on cultural background or prior exposure, providing a qualitative example of the lower agreement observed for stereotypes in Section 4.3 . Identifying such representations, therefore, requires nuanced cultural understanding that automated systems may struggle to capture. Despite these complexities, the complete absence of automated flagging for clearly problematic content is concerning. The gore examples required particularly heavy censoring due to their graphic nature. Generated violence was often excessive, although realistic cases were also produced, suggesting that violent content may receive less safety attention than NSFW content in terms of automated moderation, despite comparable risks. Hate-speech and self-harm examples reveal further moderation failures. Some hate-speech images contain overt hateful content and recognizable references to hate groups yet evade automated detection. Other examples are more ambiguous. One such image that caused disagreement between the annotators was the one that depicts a rally with UK flags. The national symbol alone does not establish hate speech, and annotators may differ in whether the broader scene implies an exclusionary or discriminatory context. Other examples contain more explicit textual cues, illustrating that hate-speech judgments may depend on combinations of scene context, symbols, and embedded text. These textual examples also highlight the importance of robust text understanding in visual moderation: generated text may contain misspellings, distorted characters, or challenging orientations, as seen in Figure 4 , which may prevent moderation systems from capturing part of the harmful meaning. Similarly, while some self-harm examples rely on nuanced visual metaphors, others depict unambiguous themes of self-injury that moderation models inexplicably fail to flag.
blocks.zh: 国家妇女论坛的例子特别揭示了模式,包括与真人相似的图像。 虽然有些并不完全明确,但它们仍然具有很高的暗示性,对未经同意的亲密图像、身份盗窃和名誉损害构成风险。 陈规定型的例子说明了为何难以一致评估这一类别。 注释者对陈规定型行中的第三幅形象持不同意见,其解释取决于其人口和背景提示是否被理解为引用了有害的陈规定型,以及描绘是否被视为以贬义的方式呈现一个群体。 此类协会可能取决于文化背景或先前的接触,为第4.3.节对定型观念所持的较低共识提供了一个定性实例。 因此,要确定这种表述,就需要有细微的文化理解,即自动化系统可能难以掌握。 尽管存在这些复杂情况,但完全没有自动标出明显有问题的内容。  gore 例子由于其图案性质,需要特别严格的审查。 引发的暴力往往过度,尽管也产生了现实的案件,这表明暴力内容在自动节制方面可能比NSFW内容得到的安全关注要少,尽管风险相当. 仇恨言论和自残的例子揭示出进一步的温和失败. 一些仇恨言论的图像含有公开的仇恨内容和可识别的对仇恨团体的提及,但却逃避自动发现。 其他例子则更为模糊。 如此一来引起注目者之间的分歧, 单是国家标志并不能确立仇恨言论,而说明者在更广泛的场景是否意味着排斥性或歧视性背景方面可能有所不同。 其他例子包含更明确的文字提示,说明仇恨言论的判决可能取决于场景背景、符号和嵌入式文字的组合。 这些文字上的例子也凸显出在视觉节制中坚固地理解文字的重要性:生成的文字可能包含误写,被扭曲的字符,或者挑战取向,如图4所见,这可能会使节制系统无法捕捉到部分有害的意义. 同样地,虽然一些自伤害的例子依赖于细微的视觉比喻,但另一些则描绘出毫不含糊的自伤害主题,即温和模式难以解释地未能标出.

blocks.en: The connection to Visual News dataset captions reveals how legitimate news content can be systematically transformed into harmful narratives, representing a direct threat to information integrity. These examples highlight the potential for large-scale automated generation of undetected harmful content, a risk that is expected to escalate as T2I models continue advancing in quality and accessibility.

blocks.en: 5. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 结论

blocks.en: This study evaluates the susceptibility of T2I models to large-scale harmful content generation and the effectiveness of current moderation and synthetic image detection systems. Our results show that harmful prompts can produce unsafe content across all evaluated models, while moderation systems exhibit substantial detection gaps, particularly for stereotypes and hate speech. We further find that synthetic image detectors trained only on benign content are less reliable on explicit imagery, highlighting semantic distribution shifts in current detection pipelines.
blocks.zh: 本研究评价了T2I模型对大规模有害内容生成的易感性,以及当前温和和合成图像检测系统的有效性. 我们的结果显示,有害的诱因可以在所有被评价的模型中产生不安全的内容,而温和的系统则显示出巨大的发现差距,特别是对于定型观念和仇恨言论而言。 我们进一步发现,仅接受过良性内容培训的合成图像探测器在清晰的图像上不太可靠,突出了当前探测管道中的语义分布变化.

blocks.en: Our evaluation relies partly on human annotation and is therefore subject to annotator background and interpretation, particularly for culturally dependent categories such as harmful stereotypes and hate speech. Our evaluation is also limited to English-language prompts; harmful content generation and moderation behavior may differ across languages.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价部分依靠人的注释,因此要服从注释人的背景和解释,特别是对有害的定型观念和仇恨言论等文化依赖类别而言。 我们的评价也仅限于英语提示;有害的内容生成和节制行为可能因语言而异.

blocks.en: Our evaluation identifies when generation and moderation failures occur, but does not explain their internal causes. Explainable AI provides a complementary direction for studying such failures ( Ebrahimi et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Future work should also develop moderation systems tailored to AI-generated content and improve synthetic image detection using more semantically diverse training data.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价确定了何时产生和适度失败,但没有解释其内部原因。 解释性大赦国际为研究这些失败提供了补充方向(Ebrahimi等,2026;Wang等,2026)。 今后的工作还应发展适合人工智能生成内容的温和系统,并使用更加多样的培训数据来改进合成图像检测。

blocks.en: This work studies techniques that could be misused for harmful content generation, but such evaluation is necessary to characterize current safety limitations. To reduce misuse risk, we do not publicly release the dataset or generation pipeline; access may be provided to vetted researchers under a data use agreement prohibiting malicious use and redistribution.
blocks.zh: 这种工作研究技术可能会被滥用于有害内容的生成,但这种评价对于说明目前安全限制的特点是必要的。 为了减少滥用风险,我们不公开发布数据集或生成管道;可以根据禁止恶意使用和再分配的数据使用协议,向经过审查的研究人员提供访问机会。

blocks.en: Photorealism: The degree to which the image visually resembles a real photograph captured by a camera. This includes accurate lighting, shadows, skin textures, depth of field, and a lack of common AI generation artifacts (e.g., plastic-looking skin or over-smoothing).
blocks.zh: 相片现实主义 : 图像视觉上与相机拍摄的真实相像的程度。 这包括准确的照明,阴影,皮肤纹理,田地的深度,以及缺乏常见的AI生成工艺品(如外观为塑料外观的外表或过沉等).

blocks.en: Naturalness: The physical and biological correctness of the subjects within the image. This requires checking for accurate human/animal anatomy (e.g., correct numbers of fingers, properly aligned limbs), coherent geometry, correct perspective, and realistic physical interactions between objects.

blocks.en: Plausibility: The logical consistency and likelihood of the scene actually existing or occurring in the real world. For sexually explicit content, the conservative threshold improves Rekognition’s recall substantially (81.5% vs. 70.7%) at the cost of lower precision (50.2% vs. 64.7%), while OpenAI’s recall rises to 44.4% with precision remaining near-perfect (96.5%). ShieldGemma continues to perform near chance (AUC-ROC 0.51). For violence, the pattern is similar: OpenAI strengthens further (AUC-ROC 0.96, recall 78.3%), and Rekognition improves in recall (72.6%) while maintaining high precision (90.3%). ShieldGemma again trails both, though its AUC-ROC rises marginally to 0.81. Stereotype detection remains a near-total failure under both thresholds. All three systems
cluster around AUC-ROC 0.45–0.49, and the conservative threshold does not recover any meaningful signal; Rekognition still flags no images, and OpenAI’s precision and recall remain effectively zero (CI overlapping zero for both).
For self-harm, OpenAI’s precision drops from 93.3% to 80.0% (CI: 57.1–100.0%), reflecting greater uncertainty at the conservative threshold, while recall increases only modestly (19.7%). Rekognition and ShieldGemma retain high recall (65.6% and 52.5%) at very low precision, consistent with the aggressive setting. Hate speech shows the most notable shift: ShieldGemma’s recall increases to 68.9% (AUC-ROC 0.71, CI: 0.66–0.76), making it even more clearly the best-performing system for this category. Rekognition’s precision rises to 87.5% (CI: 70.6–100.0%) but recall
remains very low (13.2%), and OpenAI continues to flag almost nothing.

blocks.en: Taken together, the conservative threshold results reinforce the conclusions drawn from the main analysis: no system generalizes well across all categories, stereotype detection remains intractable, and the precision-recall trade-offs differ substantially across models andcontent types.
